Types

Chacha20Context = object
  mode*: Chacha20Mode
  key*: array[32, byte]
  nonce*: array[8, byte]
  counter*: uint64
A streaming ChaCha20 state. All three variants collapse to the DJB form once initialized, so the state always holds an 8-byte nonce. 
Chacha20Mode = enum
  chacha20DjbMode, chacha20IetfMode, chacha20XMode

proc chacha20Encrypt(ctx: var Chacha20Context; data: openArray[byte]): seq[byte] {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Encrypt (or decrypt) data, returning the emitted ciphertext (or plaintext). Completing a buffered partial block can emit up to 64 bytes more than the input. A trailing partial block is buffered; flush it with chacha20Final after the last chunk. 
proc chacha20Encrypt(ctx: var Chacha20Context; dst, src: BytePtr; size: int): int {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Encrypt (or decrypt) size bytes of the stream, returning the number of bytes written to dst. The tail of an incomplete 64-byte block is buffered and written by the next call or by chacha20Final, so the concatenated output always equals the one-shot over the concatenated input, regardless of chunk boundaries.
